message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties**. This figure includes:

| Category | Approximate Numbers |
|----------|---------------------|
| Killed / mortally wounded | ~8,000 |
| Wounded | ~12,000 |
| Missing / captured | ~5,000 |

These estimates come from contemporary military reports and modern historical analyses. The exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places total casualties in the mid‑20s of thousands.
